mapper.sql: select inventory_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, color_name, size_name, spec_name, batch_no, available_qty, locked_qty, unit_price, unit_name, update_time, remark from erp_inventory
mapper.insert: insert into erp_inventory(warehouse_id, warehouse_name, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, color_name, size_name, spec_name, batch_no, available_qty, locked_qty, unit_price, unit_name, update_time, remark) values(#{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{colorName}, #{sizeName}, #{specName}, #{batchNo}, #{availableQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{unitName}, sysdate(), #{remark})

insert into erp_inventory(warehouse_id, warehouse_name, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, color_name, size_name, spec_name, batch_no, available_qty, locked_qty, unit_price, unit_name, update_time, remark) values(#{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{colorName}, #{sizeName}, #{specName}, #{batchNo}, #{availableQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{unitName}, sysdate(), #{remark}) on duplicate key update inventory_id = last_insert_id(inventory_id), warehouse_name = values(warehouse_name), item_code = values(item_code), item_name = values(item_name), color_name = values(color_name), size_name = values(size_name), spec_name = values(spec_name), available_qty = ifnull(available_qty, 0) + values(available_qty), unit_price = values(unit_price), unit_name = values(unit_name), update_time = sysdate(), remark = values(remark)
mapper.update: update erp_inventory set available_qty = ifnull(available_qty, 0) + #{qty}, unit_price = ifnull(#{unitPrice}, unit_price), update_time = sysdate() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId}
